source.levelInventoryScope: The frozen native inventory contains 75 unresolved level identities. The exact archive audit confirms the same 75 identities in the 794-level build 83 package.

licenseFinding: The pinned CE License.txt says image, music and sound creators retain full rights and permits those assets to be copied only to run NeoLemmix. Normalising the listed name 'l2 polar' to the style identifier l2_polar leaves 17 of the 44 referenced identifiers without a matching listed owner. No redistribution permission is recorded here. This inventory is a rights follow-up list, not a legal interpretation.

bundledScope.userDirection: Keep all 794 currently bundled levels in closure scope. Do not reclassify the 75 affected levels as open-ended imports.

attributionResearch.styleNameConvention: The NeoLemmix style guide says custom style names should usually start with the creator's username. A prefix is a lead, not proof of authorship or permission.
